'''Flitchee''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who had a uniform medium- to dark-brown fur coat. Flitchee wore a brown hood with a feather placed above his right ear and a holster around his shoulder.

==Biography==
Flitchee was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Homeworld Security Command|native]] to the Forest [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="EwoksFromEndor" /> who lived among the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> They participated in the ground assault at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends#The_ground_assault|Battle of Endor]]. At some point during the battle, Flitchee "acquired" an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] from a stormtrooper. Flitchee celebrated ferociously, by dramatically waving the new blaster around, upon the destruction of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] by [[Tempest Scout 2/Legends|Tempest Scout 2]], which had been commandeered by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and the ewoks, [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]] and [[Wunka/Legends|Wunka]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Flitchee had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], tan skin, and black colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> The Ewok's [[Gender/Legends|male]] name was that of the Ewok deity [[Flitchee (spirit)|Flitchee]], a mischievous [[Fire/Legends|fire]] spirit.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Endor, Flitchee wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|cowl]] with a red feather and a brown satchel. At some point during that battle, they used<ref name="RotJ" /> an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], a standard [[Blaster/Legends|sidearm]] used by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> They also used a red cowl and a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] kept in a green sheath.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flitchee is best known for jumping out of the bushes, and onto a log, waving an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] after Chewbacca destroys an AT-ST appearing at 1:42:33 on the Special Edition DVD.

In [[2012]], a [[Toys "R" Us]] exclusive action figure pack, the ''Ewok Pack'' from [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Movie Heroes]]'' line, contained a figure for this character and assigned the name "Flitchee" on the packaging. As packaged, Flitchee is not wearing the character's screen used hood, however the back of the packaging depicts him this way, with the hood supplied and located directly above his packaged location.<ref name="Hasbro" />
